correctness.rationale: For each edge orbit, explicit potentials solve Lu=e_x−e_y on a connected graph, and the exact row ℓ1 norms are obtained by summing absolute potential differences. Algebraic row comparisons establish the maximum in each h regime. The strict >2 threshold and n=10 minimum follow from rh>2(r+h), the fixed-order optimization follows from a discrete first difference, and the nonattained supremum follows from explicit asymptotics. A pure rational checker independently reconstructed 56 Laplacians and passed 2,884 exact comparisons; all-size scope follows from the proof, not finite tests.
